_about: CAMP [the heal button, damage that stays], rule 226 (Paolo 10/26: 'in Battle Brothers you can't just do fights back to back, your people need to heal... healing is important, the damage you sustained in battle'). The company's condition between fights: how fast the hitpoints a man lost come back with the map's clock, how fast his armour is mended with TAPE (rule 209: tape is the repair tools), and what making camp and the retinue change. Every number is Battle Brothers' own, read from the wiki copy in the repo (reference/library/grok/wiki/PAGES_ALL.tar.gz), the hard end of rule 117's slider (rule 226 is newer and names Battle Brothers' rates). engine/bohemia_condition.js reads this file; it carries the same numbers as its own defaults so the game works before the file lands. TUNING's one table reads the rows from here (NOTE on TUNING's board). MECHANISM-MINE / CONTENTS-PAOLO'S: the rates are a ruling (226), the felt number is TUNING's to move.

hp_per_hour_march.unit: hitpoints a man gets back an hour on the map
hp_per_hour_march.source: bb_all/0160_Attributes.txt: 'On the world map lost hitpoints are recovered at a rate of 1HP/hour on march and 2HP/hour while camping or escorting a caravan.'
hp_per_hour_march.scaled: x5 by rule 264 (Paolo 10/26: 'the timing that's natural in Battle Brothers is not the same natural as it is in Bohemia... some of the things have to be a lot quicker for us'): records/BOHEMIA_TUNING_HEALING_ON_OUR_CLOCK_10_26_26.md (our gap between fights MEASURED on the live demo, 4.6 game hours over 602 real trips, against Battle Brothers' about 24: the ratio 5.2) and records/BOHEMIA_COORDINATOR_THE_PACE_MATH_OUR_DAY_AGAINST_BATTLE_BROTHERS_10_26_26.md (the coordinator's default x4, moved to the measured x5)

struck_down_fresh.picked_by: CAMP 10/26, a default for TUNING's one table: Battle Brothers gives a struck-down survivor only the permanent injury, so the fresh part has no wiki row of its own; each mark is matched to the temporary injury of the same body part it is the healed-wrong form of (an eye socket for the eye, a knee cap for the knee)

struck_down_fresh_full_share.unit: the share of the fresh wound's Battle Brothers penalty a man carries the day he wakes; it falls in a straight line to nothing on the last of his days (a wound is worst fresh), so a man struck down fights at his worst only if he is sent at once
struck_down_fresh_full_share.source: records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_STRUCK_DOWN_HE_STILL_FIGHTS_AND_HIS_FACE_SHOWS_IT_10_26_26.md (rule 234(b) and (c): 'blood and a band-aid that come off as it heals')
struck_down_fresh_full_share.picked_by: CAMP 10/26, a default for TUNING's one table: the whole wiki penalty at the start, nothing at the end, a straight line between (realism first, rule 8/4)
